scenes.title_cn: 拍逆光：遮光 + 两臂距离
scenes.title_en: Backlight: Shade the Lens From Two Arm-Lengths
scenes.context: 当你的朋友不会拍照时，教她拍逆光：摄影师距离模特两个手臂的距离，拿出一把伞，或者用手遮住镜头前的光，放大焦距到两倍，额头卡在第一条线上。语域：拍照教学，口令式。
sentences: 当你的朋友不会拍照时，拍逆光。
When your friend can't take good photos, shoot backlit.
shoot backlit（拍逆光）
摄影师距离模特两个手臂的距离。
The photographer stands two arm-lengths from the model.
two arm-lengths（两个手臂距离）
拿出一把伞，或者用手遮住镜头前的光。
Use an umbrella or shade the light with your hand.
shade the light（遮光）
paraphrase: 遮光 → shade the light / block the light
scenes.speak: When your friend can't take good photos, shoot backlit. The photographer stands two arm-lengths from the model. Use an umbrella or shade the light with your hand.

scenes.title_en: Full Body: 0.7x, Squat, Phone at Waist
scenes.context: 拍全身：焦距调到0.7，摄影师后退一步蹲下，手机跟模特腰部齐平，垂直于地面，再内扣15度，人物放在中下两格，头顶留白三分之一，脚底贴边。语域：拍照教学，参数口令。
sentences: 拍全身，焦距调到0.7。
For a full-body shot, set the focal length to 0.7.
focal length（焦距）
摄影师后退一步蹲下，手机跟模特腰部齐平。
Step back and squat so the phone lines up with the model's waist.
lines up with the waist（与腰齐平）
头顶留白三分之一，脚底贴边。
Leave a third of headroom above and keep the feet near the edge.
headroom（留白）
paraphrase: 齐平 → line up with / level with
scenes.speak: For a full-body shot, set the focal length to 0.7. Step back and squat so the phone lines up with the model's waist. Leave a third of headroom above and keep the feet near the edge.

scenes.title_en: Half Body: Phone Level With the Head
scenes.context: 拍半身：摄影师后退一步，手机和头齐平，向外倾斜30度，放大两倍焦距，头顶留白一格。语域：拍照教学，参数口令。
sentences: 拍半身，摄影师后退一步。
For a half-body shot, the photographer steps back one step.
half-body shot（半身）
手机和头齐平，向外倾斜30度。
Keep the phone level with the head, tilted outward 30 degrees.
tilted outward（向外倾斜）
放大两倍焦距，头顶留白一格。
Zoom to 2x and leave one grid of headroom.
one grid of headroom（留白一格）
paraphrase: 向外倾斜 → tilt outward / angle away
scenes.speak: For a half-body shot, the photographer steps back one step. Keep the phone level with the head, tilted outward 30 degrees. Zoom to 2x and leave one grid of headroom.

scenes.context: 拍坐姿：摄影师退两步，手机高于头顶，镜头与脸平行，下两格构图，腿向前伸，脚贴近画面边缘。语域：拍照教学，收尾参数。
sentences: 坐姿：退两步，手机高于头顶。
Seated: step back twice, holding the phone above the head.
above the head（高于头顶）
镜头与脸平行，下两格构图。
Keep the lens parallel to the face and compose in the lower two grids.
compose in the lower grids（下格构图）
腿向前伸，脚贴近画面边缘。
Stretch the legs forward, feet near the frame edge.
the frame edge（画面边缘）
paraphrase: 构图 → compose / frame the shot
贴近边缘 → near the edge / at the rim
near the edge · at the rim
scenes.speak: Seated: step back twice, holding the phone above the head. Keep the lens parallel to the face and compose in the lower two grids. Stretch the legs forward, feet near the frame edge.

practice: Shoot backlit — stand two arm-lengths away and shade the light.
For a full body, set 0.7x and squat so the phone lines up with the waist.
Keep the phone level with the head, tilted outward 30 degrees.
Hold the phone above the head and compose in the lower two grids.
pitfalls: Shoot backlit — stand two arm-lengths away.
The phone is same with the waist.
The phone lines up with the model's waist.
「与腰齐平」用 lines up with the waist。
Leave a third of headroom above.
Keep the feet near the frame edge.
「脚底贴边」用 near the frame edge。
shifts: 拍全身只会 take full body
用 focal length（焦距）、0.7x、squat（蹲下）、lines up with the waist（与腰齐平）
用 grid（网格）、headroom（留白）、lower two grids（下两格）、frame edge（画面边缘）
用 tilt outward（向外倾斜）、level with（齐平）、parallel（平行）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：第一条线→构图网格线、中下两额→中下两格、内扣15度、头顶留白、脚底贴边、焦距0.7、手机与腰齐平、向外倾斜30度等。
